scope: Only blink, veiled-chest, planar-gate, etherealness, plane-shift and teleport. Etherealness retains separate Illusion and Transmutation routes. Authored-index application only; no runtime selection, class access change, other identity, global cosmology, balance, human-play or release approval.

sharedRules.rule: All six identities are proposed authored procedures, pending independent exact acceptance/application. Current637applied/211pending/0accepted-unapplied. No other spell/feat/class/cosmology acceptance changes.

Native cards/access and historical aliases remain full preserved. All additions below are NEW local Director choices, not recovered manuscript lore. Original cosmos first plus actual owner corrections; no Wheel/original realm/website equivalence, Heartcell builder, soul/native origin or campaign epoch is supplied.

A legal destination needs actual planeKey/siteId/frame, recorded designation/knowledge, bounded domain and a full pose/cargo mapping. Foot anchors use x/y center,z bottom; feet units. Whole bodies/items retain size, mass, orientation and velocity unless an exact map rotates them rigidly. A bounded map has explicit inverse or none; leaving its domain invalidates future use. No universal Ethereal border, phasing through walls, flight, immunity, cross-plane vision or air is granted. Unknown designation/mapping fails known preflight without payment; private new occupancy/blocker after legal designation gives paid nondiagnostic failure.

Ordinary components/actual acquired repertoire/rank/action/phase/custody/consent/range/LoE and known blockers first. Then actual RP, concentration transition and Dissonance/Refrain commit before counters/hidden checks. Completed instantaneous moves cannot be dispelled or rewound by later Antimagic. Atomic group failure keeps the whole same actual group at origin, without restoring paid costs. Every independently carried creature counts; unique body and containment/custody graph closes the group; no duplicate roots, unconsenting passengers or free release.

Finite neutral ordered candidate poses are declared before resolution. Test each entire body/cargo volume, receiving support, solid boundaries and all pairwise interpenetration; no remote search outside the finite region, no split body, no nearest-safe-space oracle. Magical endpoint prevention and physical occupancy are separate. Failure reveals only failure, with private reasons retained. Real hazards after arrival resolve under actual sources, not a fictitious transit damage/Null root.

Dimensional Anchor uses its actual fixed60ft sphere and any actual origin/destination footprint; Gate formation is not transit. No Escape prevents voluntary teleport/extra-dimensional travel, not forced physical passage. Verdict Absolute prevents voluntary TELEPORT only; Reign of Ashes prevents benefit from TELEPORT after its actual failed save, not every planar effect. Gate is physical planar nonteleport; the other five displacements are planar teleport (Teleport same-plane only). No source-specific Banishment return exception is imported. Planar Barrier needs affirmative source-linked classification and actual thickness intersection, not merely a visitor. Lesser Antimagic checks actual source/local manifestation, never an imagined straight line.

Select AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03/actual Planar Protection prospective-origin check for each cross-plane transaction here. Snapshot actual immediate origin plane before checking destination, not old arrival history. Commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey only after success, keeping creation provenance separate. Failure/same-plane Teleport retains old value. This is operational history, not native/soul identity. Forbiddance is actual alignment-selected damage on entry/START with its per-round cap; never a travel ban.

Only the explicitly bounded NEW synthetic sites below adopt equal elapsed seconds. Every actual Dying/Stable, disease, Decay, food, concentration, rest/resource, Hunt and campaign Opening2400h/Horn1200h clock retains source and advances normally. No rest is completed by arrival, no duration or resource refresh. A place with an independently adopted incompatible time rule remains unsupported until its conversion is actually authored. Transport never settles Extraction, cargo/taxes/credentials or epoch.

Serialize private checks/source data separately from recipient observations. No cause/ward/provenance/contents/class-roster diagnostic on failure; only independently visible results may be observed. No hidden acknowledgment/search/fishing, RNG reroll, extra Fate presentation or retrospective dodge.

spells.procedure:
Action;60ft;V/S/M-or-F;rank3/base5RP. Select one perceived presently willing creature within60ft/LoE, including self, and one actual paired Material/Ethereal site map. NEW replace insufficient Instantaneous metadata with60elapsed seconds, nonconcentration. This particular source starts in Material; both map directions must be defined before payment. Preserve one body and all eligible worn/held noncreature cargo; independently carried creatures make this single-recipient cast illegal. One live Blink per recipient across casters: successful later Blink on that same recipient replaces the old application at its original place with no immediate extraction; only a paid successfully resolved new source supplies its own deadline/RNG sequence. Different recipients do not replace each other. Failed new casts do not replace.
At resolution+6,+12,...,+54 seconds, process each immutable sourceId:pulseIndex once in total event order. First attempt any return owed from the previous pulse. Mandatory return is nonvoluntary. Return tests the fixed ordered original return candidates and all real endpoint wards; no bypass. If no candidate is legal, the pulse is spent at the current real pose and no new departure is attempted. A current resident that independently left either paired domain or moved by another lawful cross-plane source is detached permanently from this application without an extra extraction.
If actually back in Material and this pulse is operative, draw one fair d2:1stay,2optional departure. Consume the draw even when current consent/known physical/ward gates deny that departure; source-suppressed/missed opportunities consume the marker without draw or backlog. Consent is rechecked for every optional departure. Entry uses the current material pose mapped into the bounded Ethereal site. No free movement or interaction across planes; ordinary native turns and actual senses on the current plane persist. The next pulse attempts return to the recorded departure pose/candidates, regardless of Ethereal movement within the admitted domain.
At60seconds, early whole-source dispel or recipient death, end the application and attempt one final mandatory return if an attached resident is in the paired Ethereal site. If magical prevention or all candidate physical volumes block settlement, end with the same resident/remains actually stranded there. No retry debt, cell, safety/air, free later return or healing is created. Local suppression of a current application denies optional pulses; it does not itself end the body or extract it, and the fixed terminal checkpoint still occurs with all actual endpoint/suppression blockers. Caster death alone does not end this nonconcentration source. Duplicate deliveries are no-ops. An earlier attack resolves fully before a later pulse; ordinary Blink randomness is not Fate replacement.

spells.procedure:
Veiled Chest remains its own identity. Leomund historical alias is evidence only; NEW explicitly choose Action,60ft,V/S/F,rank4/base7RP matching that corroborating envelope, without miniature chest/gold/loss import. Choose one actual coherent closed unattached chest within60ft/perception/LoE, all independent custodians consenting, full actual physical contents/capacity and one known supported Ethereal storage pose. Chest capacity is that actual object record, not a universal spell capacity. Contents may include ordinary nested unlinked containers and real nonliving remains. Living or still-creature-origin transformed bodies and another active Veiled Chest are excluded, even when hidden; known failure pays nothing, private hidden contents cause paid generic failure. A link supplies no creature transport/life support.
NEW one live link per caster for24elapsed hours. Successful storage relocates the same entire chest/cargo once; creates no pocket plane, duplicate matter or token. A second storage is known illegal until the old link ends; it never silently loses an earlier chest. Link is an owner-attached magical expression; storage destination is physical matter. Owner may spend an actual Action plus2RP to recall that link, a new Veiled-Chest-only magical NONSPELL operation, not a second class spell or free general remote retrieval. Owner must be conscious/alive; designation must include a currently perceived supported arrival pose within10ft/LoE, complete predetermined finite candidates, all present custodians consenting, whole chest/cargo fit, same real chest intact and contents still eligible. Existing link identifies this chest only, not a hidden location oracle. Actual blocker/Antimagic checks apply at owner, actual chest and arrival; paid hidden failure consumes Action/2RP with no matter moved or diagnostic. Success closes the link and lands every same item once.
Owner death,24h expiry, whole-link dispel or physical breakup ends only the link, leaving all actual remote physical residents where they are. Local link suppression prevents recall without deleting/moving chest; its clock continues. Storage chest suppression cannot erase ordinary matter. Destruction produces actual fragments and liberated contents according to its real cause; no fragment is the intact recall target. Another source may lawfully retrieve real fragments/cargo but this spell does not reconstruct/locate them. No automatic mandatory return or ward exception exists.

spells.procedure:
Action;60ft;V/S/F;rank5/base10RP;native60elapsed seconds, NEW nonconcentration. Choose a perceived supported origin mouth within60ft/LoE and one previously personally documented different-plane receiving site/pose. Fixed bidirectional vertical clear aperture5ft wide8ft high with0.1ft thickness; record orthonormal tangent/up/outward-normal bases at each mouth. NEW physical planar gateway, NOT teleportation. Whole receiving volumes and declared neutral staging candidates are checked on each crossing, not just formation. Formation itself moves nothing and Anchor does not prevent mere aperture creation.
Only actual creature-led complete whole-body/cargo groups can cross. A fitting crossing requires at least5ft continuous real movement, or the whole group axial depth when greater (a20ft rigid beam needs20ft), paid from its actual movement/forced source, with full swept body and rigid carried item admission. The0.1ft mouth has two actual boundary faces, not an extra ordinary tunnel: entry-front surface x=-0.05 maps directly to exit-front x=1000.05 by the proper rigid world transform R=identity,t=(1000.1,0,0). Thus a5ft body staged atx=-2.55 moves5ft to virtualx=2.45 and lands at1002.55, with its rear exactly outside the exit slab. The other paired back surfaces use t=(999.9,0,0); reverse directions use the inverse translations. This explicit NEW junction removes the mouth interior from the ordinary path; it creates no extra distance, tactical rotation, mirroring or half-body state. Front local tangents reverse sign because the outward-facing bases oppose; world facing/velocity are preserved by R. Unsupported arrival is not accepted. All independently carried bodies consent for voluntary use; forced movement needs its own actual source and distance, and separately tests all actual arrival gates. Unknown new occupancy after committed traversal fails atomically at origin with actual committed traversal movement spent; known impossible crossing commits none. Separate travelers have separate events and current checks. No traversable partial half-body state is serialized.
NEW aperture is locally visible as one uniform dark opaque rectangle; it reveals no remote sight/sound/LoE and admits no attacks. Local suppression visibly removes that local mouth, not an aura or location diagnostic for Antimagic itself. Neither ordinary loose objects, fluids nor independent projectiles use it. They remain on their current plane, obeying ordinary local collisions; no invisible blade/wall/launch damage is supplied. Carried ordinary cargo can cross only with its actual carrier. This limitation is explicitly selected, not inferred from Alignment Portal or Faction Portal.
Mouths are fixed world poses, not attached to a later-moving platform. Loss of actual mouth support invalidates that mouth for the rest of this source. An overlapping suppressor closes only that mouth’s admission while the fixed source clock continues; no transport is undone. Caster death, class suppression or travel alone does not end this independently created nonconcentration spell; actual whole-source removal ends both mouths. The original caster/rank/DC/deadline record remains fixed. One source per caster: successful new Gate replaces old; costs/counters precede replacement. At exact deadline, an already legally committed crossing with stable event order before closure finishes atomically first, then mouths end; no new equality-time crossing may commit after closure. Suppression/end grants no return/rescue to far-side residents.
